subject: END QA-POINTER-INPUT-20261005: evidence ready, no production fix
body:
# Pointer input review: 5 October 2026

QA-only window `QA-POINTER-INPUT-20261005`. Production UI, engine, art and shared bundles were not edited.

## Result

The standalone Move failure did not reproduce. All six first Move clicks entered movement mode, and all 23 captured Move clicks across the main cases had a settled movement mode. An open-guide interception of phone hero selection did reproduce. This is a bounded layout finding, not proof that the historical Move anomaly had the same cause.

The real browser used trusted mouse pointer events at viewport dimensions 390 × 844, 768 × 1024 and 1280 × 800. These are viewport-emulated mouse tests, not physical touch or Android tests. Each case started from a genuine zero-command disposable private mission using the real route/controller/reducer. No state injection, unlock certificate or completed mission was fabricated.

## Observed cases

| Mission | Phone with guide open | Tablet | Desktop |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unequal Crossing T1, seed 3, river, Bushel/Furrow/Pip | Select Bushel hits guide ASIDE at (190,662); Furrow stays selected; Move opens for Furrow | Bushel selected; Move opens | Bushel selected; Move opens |
| Turning Ravine T3, seed 2, river, Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly | Select Barrow hits guide ASIDE at (190,662); Amberly stays selected; Move opens for Amberly | Barrow selected; Move opens | Barrow selected; Move opens |

Ravine phone selection was retried with the guide still open and missed again. After using Hide guide, hero selection, Move, visible reachable destination, Cancel and Confirm all worked in both missions and all three viewports. T1 phone used one cancel then one confirm; the other five used two cancels then one confirm. The final record in each case contains exactly one legal move at expected revision 0. The moving hero has 1 AP, all other heroes retain 2 AP, stars and packs stay at zero and tier awards remain empty. Every preconfirmation trace and progress export is byte-identical to its zero-command baseline.

## QA layout control

The original fixture has an 83px QA header above the route. This reduces the space available to the route and must not be confused with the integrated App layout. Two additional fresh phone cases used an optional compact header, measured at 28px including padding:

- Unequal Crossing T1 still missed Bushel selection: the trusted pointer hit ASIDE at (190,644), Furrow remained selected and Move opened.
- Turning Ravine T3 selected Barrow successfully, with the trusted pointer reaching the Select Barrow button's nested content. Move opened.

Both controls remained at zero commands with unchanged trace and progress. Ravine interception therefore depends on available layout height. T1 interception survives the smaller fixture header, but integrated App reproduction is still required before generalising the finding. The guide visibly extends over the party card area in the saved T1 phone image.

## Evidence and verification

`verify-pointer-input-proof.mjs` passed: six main cases, 85 exported stages, 23 Move clicks; two compact controls, six further exported stages. All eight initial/final records replay independently with matching state hashes. The checkpoint also confirms the production source hashes remain identical to the accepted selected-info checkpoint.

Evidence in this directory:

- `pointer-input-checkpoint-20261005.json`: assertions, captured interception events, final hashes and frozen production hashes.
- `pointer-*-*.json`: stage exports containing trace, progress and passive native event logs.
- `pointer-t1-phone-missed-hero.png`, `pointer-compact-t1-phone-initial-pointer.png`: guide overlap.
- `pointer-t1-phone-final-pointer.png` and the other five `*-final-pointer.png` images: one confirmed legal move.
- `pointer-input-initial-fixture.html`: preserved original executable fixture; `pointer-input-ui-preview.html`: current fixture with the optional compact-header comparison. Main-case default layout is unchanged.

Owned helpers: `pointer-input-recorder.jsx`, `build-pointer-input-ui-preview.cjs`, generated `pointer-input-ui-preview.jsx` and `verify-pointer-input-proof.mjs`. The recorder observes document events and exports them to hidden QA DOM; it does not change game state or intercept input.

No speculative production fix was made. The next bounded investigation should reproduce guide containment in the integrated App at the same phone dimensions, then decide whether the guide should scroll or remain within the map area. No full regression, shared build, additional win, certified bank, device acceptance or whole-Orchard acceptance is claimed.
